name: team_replace
unavailable: The person allows one agent in this chat: there is no team. Do the work yourself.
description: Replace a subagent — one that ran out of context, or one that is stuck: it ends (stopped, if it has not already), and a new one with the same name, position, parent, mode and model takes its place, briefed with `task` (default: the old task) and the old one's findings. The subagents under it move under the new one.
